claims.statement: Read the exact supplied primary PDFs at the note locators, using the extraction only to navigate. Verify the L10 fixed symmetric operator/trace/norm-C2 hypotheses and the explicit moving-block pullback obstruction, without declaring that every alternative realization is impossible. Verify the L11 measure coefficient mapping, positive weight atom jump, delta-prime interaction versus distributional weight distinction, and every scope statement in both source notes/cards. Selective reading is not a full-paper proof audit.

Independently verify the full finite fixed-positive-density noncolliding-interface Theorem P. Check analytic root simplicity identity, normalization/sign, uniform and H1 first differentiation across moving strips, weak measure equation, finite Green Laurent residue/gauge and atom H1 mapping, normalization kernel coefficient, full lambda second derivative and Dn half-factor, gradient-times-coordinate-acceleration term and feasibility limits. Check the conditional extension section stays conditional; no arbitrary distribution differentiability or G1/global sign follows.

Check the actual formulas C1-C6: single interface rho1/4 at a=1/2, eigenvalue versus frequency, eigenvalue index, normalized interface values, Laurent finite part and nonzero geometric term, density scaling, positive midpoint atom and right derivatives, uniform bounded-complex-lambda thin-layer transfer limit. Verify fixed continuous-kernel signed-measure concentration needs uniform TV and convergent cluster masses and does not differentiate a moving resolvent. Compare every proposed card to these exact scopes.

Inspect the supplied standalone calibration code and actual execution records, and independently rerun meaningful checks or independently calculate them if available. Source project is immutable: run an unmodified copy of check_calibrations.py in a new temporary directory if needed; do not invoke the author run_checks wrapper which writes under the source root. Numerical finite differences/layer samples are corroboration, never interval certificates or global sign proofs. State actual runtime checks versus reading. No unsupplied author context or current project code may be read.
